FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their application form in response
to Advertisement Notice No. 02 of 2024, dated October 28, 2024 for the post of Deputy Registrar/
Deputy Controller of Examinations that the provisional list of applicants along with their eligibility status
is given in Annexure I (Open) & II (SC) to this Notice.
Further, the interview for the above mentioned post shall be conducted on 27.09.2025 at 1:30 PM in the
Committee Room of the Vice Chancellor’s Secretariat, University of Kashmir, Hazratbal, Srinagar -
190006.
The call letters will be dispatched to the eligible candidates on their respective addresses / email IDs.
Candidates shall be required to produce original documents in support of their candidature at the time
of interview and shall report atleast 30 minutes before the scheduled time for document verification.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
No. F/NT-Eligibility/KU/25
Dated: 03.09.2025

1. Special Secretary to the Vice Chancellor for information of the Hon’ble Vice
Chancellor;

the University website.
3. P.A. to Registrar for information of the Registrar;
